note: Read-only demo snapshot for front-end work without the server. Run npm start for the real app.

briefs.title: Review a SaaS reseller agreement
briefs.description: We are signing our first reseller in Austria and need a careful first-pass review of their paper before our GC negotiates.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall deliver a marked-up copy of the Reseller Agreement together with a written risk note of no more than one page, identifying provisions that depart materially from market standard.

briefs.title: DPA and SCC pack for a cloud migration
briefs.description: A client is moving its HR system to a US cloud provider. We need the data-processing paperwork prepared for partner review.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall prepare a draft data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR and the applicable Standard Contractual Clauses module, with a transfer impact assessment template.

briefs.title: AI Act risk-classification memo for a scoring model
briefs.description: Our client runs a credit-scoring model. We need a structured memo on how it is classified under the AI Act.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall deliver a memo of no more than eight pages classifying the system under the AI Act, listing the resulting obligations and open questions.

briefs.title: Open-source licence audit for a Series A data room
briefs.description: Our portfolio company is raising its Series A. Investors want a clean view of the open-source licences in the codebase.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall review the dependency export provided, classify each licence by obligation type and deliver a spreadsheet with a one-page summary of copyleft exposure.

briefs.title: Trademark filing support across 6 Nice classes
briefs.description: We are registering our fintech brand at the DPMA and EUIPO and need the class specifications drafted.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall draft goods and services specifications for six Nice classes and a short note on conflicting marks found in a basic search.

briefs.title: SaaS contract templates for a Series A team
briefs.description: We are standardising our customer contracts after our Series A and need a clean template set.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall deliver a master subscription agreement template, an order form and a service-level schedule, each with drafting notes.

briefs.title: BaFin outsourcing clauses for a payments integration
briefs.description: A new payments partner must meet our outsourcing requirements. We need the clauses checked against the supervisory guidance.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall compare the partner agreement with the outsourcing requirements and deliver a gap table with proposed clause wording.

briefs.title: Market-definition note for a merger filing
briefs.description: We advise on a merger filing and need a research note on how the relevant market has been defined in past decisions.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall deliver a research note of no more than six pages summarising market definitions in comparable Bundeskartellamt and Commission decisions.

briefs.title: Cookie consent and banner audit
briefs.description: Our marketing site uses several tracking tools. We want to know whether the consent banner meets current requirements.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall audit the consent banner against the TDDDG and GDPR and deliver a findings table with recommended fixes.

briefs.title: Supplier-contract red-flag summary, 30 contracts
briefs.description: Before closing, we need a quick red-flag pass across thirty supplier contracts in the data room.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall review thirty supplier contracts and deliver a red-flag summary covering change of control, exclusivity, liability caps and termination rights.

briefs.title: GmbH formation checklist for an Austrian subsidiary
briefs.description: A client is setting up a subsidiary in Vienna and needs a formation checklist.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall deliver a checklist of formation steps, documents and filing fees for an Austrian GmbH.

briefs.title: Three-week data-room sprint, full time
briefs.description: An intensive due-diligence sprint on site, five full days a week for three weeks.
briefs.scope_deliverable: The Student Employee shall index and summarise the target's commercial contracts in the data room during a three-week full-time sprint.
